adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#update` and `#destroy`, the record is fetched with `EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` and then used without a nil check. If not found, `host` is `nil`, so `save_host(host)` will raise when calling `host.host = ...`, and `destroy` will raise on `host.destroy`. Also `save_host` assumes `params[:embeddable_host]` exists (`params[:embeddable_host][:host]` / `[:category_id]`), which will raise `NoMethodError` if the key is missing. These cases would result in unhandled 500s instead of 404/400.
